todos: [P2] FULLTASK-BEHAVIORAL-CLOSURE-01: scripts/live/fullTaskRun.live.ts with qwen2.5-coder:7b still does not close 'verified'. On 2026-09-24 eight reruns (runs 4-11) each exposed and got a fix for one blocker: behavior_test_runner_missing/behavior_test_script_missing and npm test after the build (behaviorTestDirective.ts, planDirectiveArbiter.ts), a passing npm test/npm run test now counts as verification (trackVerification), npm test == npm run test in isVerificationFailing, ETARGET on a manifest range orders one package.json rewrite (processToolService.ts) and dependencies_unpublished outranks every install (pendingManifestDirective), the uninstallable-package directive quotes the import lines to delete, failing Jest/Vitest runs are diagnosed (testFailureDiagnostic.ts, assertion vs load failure), Vitest's JSX-in-.js message is recognised, a diagnosed failed check wins over unfinished milestones so move_file is granted, and the application performs a pending version-refresh read itself. Best results: run 10 6/8 verified (build green, finish called with the smoke-test milestone abandoned), run 11 6/10 (step budget). Remaining failure mode in run 11: the model rewrites already-complete files (redundant 'MILESTONE WAS ALREADY COMPLETE' results) and keeps proposing read_file, which focus turns deny (write_file only), until the step budget ends the run. Next, decide whether focus turns should grant read_file on the active target or redirect a redundant rewrite to the next unsatisfied milestone automatically, then rerun until closure is 'verified'.

[P2] GPTOSS-FULLTASK-01: GPTOSS-PLAN-JSON-01 is fixed (2026-09-24): with think:false and a JSON schema gpt-oss:20b returned empty content (827 output tokens, done_reason=stop, logged by describeInvalidStructuredResponse), so structured requests of level-only models now send think 'low' (resolveStructuredThinkValue); plan generation succeeds and the agent loop runs. The full task with ONLYRAG_LIVE_MODEL=gpt-oss:20b then ran 42/50 steps (1-4 minutes per turn, about 55 minutes) and stopped on no_mutation with 0/10 verified: after npm install and the first files it spent steps 16-41 reading files through run_command (sed -n '1,200p', cat, shasum) instead of read_file, and its one npm run build failed. Next, treat shell reads (sed/cat/type/Get-Content on a workspace file) as read_file for loop and no-mutation accounting or redirect them to read_file, act on the failed build's directive, and rerun with gpt-oss:20b.

[P3] EXPLICIT-ANY-BACKLOG-01: noExplicitAny is a warning (biome.json); on 2026-09-24 npx biome lint lists 201 explicit any (from 239): sidecarHttpClient.ts envelopes, stream events and search results are typed (SidecarStreamEvent, SidecarStreamResult, VectorSearchResult, PromptHistorySearchResult), ollamaHttpClient error handlers, toolSchemaValidator chunks, aiDebugBundleService logs and the useTranslation Monaco refs no longer use any. Remaining: mostly test doubles, sessionHistoryDomain.ts normalizers (raw persisted JSON), soundEffectsService, IPC test payloads. Next, type the session normalizers with unknown plus narrowing and the test doubles module by module, then raise noExplicitAny to error for electron/ and shared/ via a biome.json override.

[P3] I18N-MAIN-MESSAGES-01: after I18N-HARDCODED-STRINGS-01 (2026-09-24) the renderer UI, the renderer services (translate() in src/i18n/I18nContext.tsx) and the Sidecar ingestion progress (step_code/step_params) are localized, but text produced in Main still reaches the UI in Italian only: agent timeline emitLog messages and closure summaries (e.g. agentOrchestratorApplicationClosure.ts 'Chiusura applicativa', 'NON VERIFICABILE'/'BLOCCATO', agentOrchestratorToolResultProcessor.ts), Main error strings such as sidecarAppService.ts 'ID documento non valido.' and sidecarHttpClient.ts 'Eliminazione scaduta...'; the default titles 'Nuova Sessione' (electron/core/domain/sessions/sessionHistoryDomain.ts, used as a custom-title sentinel) and 'Nuova Conversazione' (src/hooks/useChatEngine.ts) are persisted data; the Sidecar chunk prefix '[Documento: … | Sezione: …]' is embedded in stored vectors. Next, give Main user-facing events a message code plus params rendered by the renderer (keeping the Italian text the model sees unchanged), replace the title sentinels with an explicit untitled flag, and leave the chunk prefix until a re-index migration exists.
